messages:
sofia.partnerships: Heads up — partners are asking about SDK v2 -> v3 compat. Marketplace listing breaks if we switch auth header without coordination. Need a consolidated timeline.

mike-prod: thanks. can we scope impacted partners? my read: SI integrators + a couple HW partners who bundle the SDK are most at risk.

aline-sdk: did a quick scan of marketplace manifests — ~7 partners reference the old header pattern, 3 pin to a runtime that won't auto-upgrade. snippet of the deprecation notice draft we pushed to internal docs:
```
Deprecation: X-Redwood-Auth header v1 will be removed on 2026-06-01. Migrate to Authorization: Bearer tokens. Grace period: 90 days.
```

raj-engineering: For the SDKs we can land a backwards-compatible shim that accepts both headers for an opt-in period (configurable TTL). low-risk patch, would like to ship canary first.

ivy-marketplace: marketplace listing metadata requires a manifest version bump when auth changes. if we change auth without updating listings partners will see 403 on install. we need coordinated listing updates + partner notifications.

sofia.partnerships: proposal: 1) announce migration to partners this week 2) release shim in SDKs (60-day support window) 3) start marketplace listing updates at day 30 4) sunsetting shim at day 90. thoughts?

mike-prod: sounds reasonable. we also need a partner comms packet (FAQ + code samples) and a rollback playbook in case major partners hit breakage.

aline-sdk: i'll draft the SDK patch today. plan: shim lives behind a feature flag, default enabled for 60d, with telemetry. PR will include unit tests + a canary job.

marketplace-bot: New marketplace submission created: https://marketplace.example.com/submission/789

raj-engineering: add a telemetry metric `deprecated_auth_seen` (bool) and a rolling alert if >1% of calls in a region still send old header after day 30. also include a config TTL so we can flip the shim off remotely.

ivy-marketplace: pinging legal for any required T&Cs changes on listing. i'll coordinate partner outreach and 1:1 migration calls for top-5 integrators.

sofia.partnerships: i'll own partner comms + coordinated timeline doc. can someone create the GTM calendar invite and include partner engineers? @mike-prod

mike-prod: will do and add the rollback playbook to the invite. sending invites now. :calendar:

aline-sdk: PR link: https://git.redwood.dev/aline/sdk/patches/old-header-shim — tagging @raj-engineering for config bits.

raj-engineering: reviewing now. leaving inline comment about TTL granularity (per-partner vs global). prefer per-partner for incremental rollback.

sofia.partnerships: great. action items: aline -> PR + canary, mike -> GTM invite + rollback doc, ivy -> legal + marketplace manifest updates, raj -> telemetry + per-partner TTL. reconvene in 48h to lock dates.

mike-prod: cool, thanks team. :thumbsup:
